_provenance.content_hash: pinned at commit e09410b6; future changes to main branch will differ
_provenance.capture_method: derived from official Gemini CLI hooks reference documentation at pinned commit. JSON examples constructed from documented stdin/stdout field descriptions.
conclusions_supported: Gemini CLI provides a hook system with JSON-over-stdin/stdout at commit e09410b6
All hooks receive base input: session_id, transcript_path, cwd, hook_event_name, timestamp
BeforeTool fires before tool invocation; documented for argument validation, security checks, parameter rewriting
BeforeTool is a POLICY/VALIDATION hook — NOT a user-approval request
No dedicated permission/approval request event exists; Notification hook explicitly cannot block or grant permissions
conclusions_not_supported: This fixture does NOT prove BeforeTool represents a user approval request
This fixture does NOT prove Pokit-session to Gemini-session correlation (requires managed launch)
This fixture does NOT prove hooks fire during ordinary interactive TUI sessions
This fixture does NOT prove the hook schema at a later commit is identical
Transcript JSON path/format is documented by third-party tools, not confirmed by pinned Gemini CLI documentation

hook_base_input._source_section: Base input schema (all hooks receive these fields)

before_tool._classification: POLICY/VALIDATION HOOK — NOT user approval evidence. Official docs: 'Fires before a tool is invoked. Used for argument validation, security checks, and parameter rewriting.' Denied reason is 'sent to the agent as a tool error.'

notification._classification: CANNOT BLOCK OR GRANT PERMISSIONS. Official docs: 'This hook cannot block alerts or grant permissions automatically. Flow-control fields are ignored.'
